column2: [intro]
I hate clowns, they give me chills,
Their forced smiles make me feel ill.
With their plastic noses and loud, gaudy makeup,
I’d much prefer a panda in my yard to wake up.
I don’t like clowns, they’re not my cup of tea,
Their silly jokes always make me grumble, you see.
Let them stay in their circus, I don’t want to cheer,
Clowns aren’t for me, I’d rather have pastries near.
They arrive in groups, painted in insane style,
Their giant shoes make me laugh in denial.
They try to amuse with endless juggling tricks,
But I find it all a bit too slick.
A red nose and flowers springing from their hand,
To some it’s fun, but to me, it’s a nightmare unplanned.
Maybe I’m odd, but I can’t reconcile,
Clowns aren’t my thing; I prefer wooden puppets’ smile.
